label: Chiaroscuro

traits.texture: soft deep shadow fields and selectively crisp illuminated edges
traits.composition: isolate the reference focal mass through large dark areas and a limited illuminated contour
traits.lighting: a single strong raking light with luminous highlights and richly compressed shadows

review_checks: Strong light-dark hierarchy organizes the image
The focal shape survives shadow compression
Illuminated edges remain controlled rather than broadly overexposed
limitations: Fine shadow details may be deliberately lost; this is an artistic tonal treatment rather than recovered photographic information.
Palette, fine geometry and cross-image consistency require visual review; generation is not deterministic.
